note: The Handover's route scripts (brief 011 B, Waymark), played headless by the mission checker (bun run missions:check handover). Rewritten 2026-10-15 for Keel's round-2 engine: the final fight (N10, N11) and the crowd are on in every script, the cast is M-2's from the promoted people run r016 (sim/data/handover.site.json cast, 2026-10-16; Inez p-cafe-14 Fearful, the guard p-records-office-01, the driver p-records-office-31 and Vale p-records-office-07 Mercenary), so route A helps Inez twice (§04: a Fearful person needs Help ×2), Watch takes 20 s and the fight's shots are untraced (Sky's balance rulings). The scripts start from Keel's scenarios where one exists (N10, N11, N11b, S09, S25, N08), without their fixtures and keeping only the orders the engine took; every fixture a script would need became orders. Keel's readings are kept: the response unit enters from the north street (§07 'west street'), one door guard stays the whole mission, and Vale follows the mission's timeline, not his routine. Closing events (Suture's question; Aster 2026-10-15): route A's is Vale's exit at 5:50 (§07 route A, before 5:50), secured when the Enforcer is inside; route B's is the mission's close, 8:30 since Sky's ruling (rivals take Vale or the car leaves), secured when Vale is with the Enforcer. A carry in progress at the close (Waymark's ruling, 2026-10-15, on Keel's E8): the close ends the take, not a carry already under way. If the Enforcer holds Vale at 8:30 the run goes on (the engine logs horizon.open) and wins only when Vale reaches the getaway car; the final fight, the seal and the Enforcer's health bound the carry. Recommended to Keel and Motive, not yet in the engine: a hard stop at 12:00 (§01: a mission is 8-12 min) where a carry still under way ends as 'district seals'. Brief 013 D (Waymark, 2026-10-16): the takedown engine (Keel 0.5.0, security level 2, the guard's check-in marks every 90 s). Route G takes the guard out (knockout; fast; kill hidden behind the service door). Careless scripts (kind careless) do the same violence seen by a camera, seen by a crowd, found before the exit, or reported unstopped, each against its careful twin (MC-7). Trail is compared in total, the mission's plus what the debrief carries into the campaign. Rev 4 (2026-10-16): a found body holds the doors in its sight (careless-guard-left-door-held); open cases are priced at the rulebook's case-trail-eq in the totals. The driver route (Motive §6.2) is still not scripted: with the pickup loop and three bodies to a service door it plays, but each staff victim's missed mark is its own incident (the second lands at Alert 2, and the search opens the service door), and every witness at the bay tells a Loyal workmate by telephone (briefs/013/waymark-handover.md §5).
